Grandma Yang's fire

No shortcuts.
No compromises.

Widowed at thirty with five children to raise, Grandma Yang set up a single charcoal stall in Guiyang. Her skewers drew such a following that the family grew it to six locations, each grilling about 10,000 skewers a day.

She kept two vows for forty years: honest, quality meat, and a spice blend crushed by hand and never written down. Her granddaughter Candice now runs our Plano kitchen with the same rules.
